communicationSetup.rohanState: Awake but fatigued. Eye gaze unreliable.
rules: Show Samira’s fear without vilifying her
Do not interpret slow response as lack of understanding
End with Rohan identifying what information he still needs

turns.speaker: Intensivist
turns.text: Rohan. Short updates. One at a time. Cheek switch yes or no after each.

turns.speaker: Communication specialist
turns.text: Scanning is on. Press when you hear the choice you want. We will wait.

turns.speaker: Intensivist
turns.text: The resistant treatment is helping control the pneumonia.

turns.speaker: Communication specialist
turns.text: Confirm: you heard pneumonia improving with current treatment — yes or no.

turns.speaker: Infectious-diseases consultant
turns.text: Kidney function is worsening while we use that treatment.

turns.speaker: Communication specialist
turns.text: Confirm: kidneys worse on current plan — yes or no.

turns.speaker: Rohan
turns.note: Slow scan selection; specialist repeats back without adding interpretation.

turns.speaker: Infectious-diseases consultant
turns.text: Changing treatment may be gentler on kidneys. Infection control may slow.

turns.speaker: Intensivist
turns.text: There is uncertainty. We do not need spoken voice for this decision.

turns.speaker: Samira
turns.text: I am frightened. I keep wanting to answer. I will wait.
turns.note: Fear acknowledged; she does not take the first answer slot.

turns.speaker: Intensivist
turns.text: Rohan — what do you still need before we choose?

turns.speaker: Rohan
turns.note: Rohan identifies information still needed — ends dialogue beat.

turns.speaker: Communication specialist
turns.text: Confirmed. We will show kidney and infection trends in short units. Then we ask again.

accessibility.captions: Each turn available as caption card with speaker label.
accessibility.reducedSensoryAlt: Text-only dialogue with learner-controlled advance; no alarm audio.
accessibility.pacing: Learner or specialist controls advance; no forced autoplay through turns.
